name: @readi/ai-worker
description: Thin wrapper so turbo can run the Python worker's tasks (uv, ruff, mypy, pytest).

scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.gen:contracts: uv run datamodel-codegen --input ../../packages/shared-types/generated/json-schema/contracts.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output readi_worker/contracts/generated/contracts.py --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --target-python-version 3.12 --use-standard-collections --use-union-operator --use-double-quotes --field-constraints --enum-field-as-literal all --collapse-root-models --disable-timestamp --formatters ruff-format --custom-file-header '# GENERATED from packages/shared-types (Zod) by `pnpm gen:contracts` (ADR-0003). Do not edit.'
